candidate.name: Anup Rao
candidate.summary: Associate Product Manager with 8+ years spanning product, engineering, and operations. Most recently drove the roadmap for ad-serving and campaign validation systems at X (Twitter). Background in React/Node, platform engineering, and enterprise ops gives me an unusually technical lens for PM work. Currently upskilling in Java, Spring Boot, and DSA — open to both Senior PM and Backend Developer roles. Comfortable in 0-to-1 and scale contexts, with a track record of improving throughput, client satisfaction, and cross-functional delivery.

experience.description: Drove the roadmap for internal ad-serving and campaign validation systems supporting global advertisers and agencies. Partnered with engineering, design, and ad operations teams to enhance creative rendering, targeting accuracy, and measurement reliability across large-scale ad systems. Prioritized engineering backlogs using data-driven insights from Datadog and Grafana, improving campaign throughput by 18%. Monitored product KPIs (impression latency, campaign success rate) to guide iteration and optimize ad delivery experiences.

Defined product requirements documents (PRDs) for truck check-in automation enhancing client satisfaction and retention. Collaborated with leadership to prioritize feature roadmap balancing operational scalability with client-driven needs. Managed end-to-end testing and rollout of new platform APIs, coordinating across design, QA, and customer onboarding teams.

Built custom UI React components and complex web forms integrating REST API services, enhancing customer validation processes. Developed JavaScript logic for business-facing web applications, contributing to the Packages Bundle + Save flow on the main website. Created training materials and conducted workshops to ensure effective client onboarding and product adoption.

Contributed to the development and maintenance of Scaler's e-learning platform, supporting over 15,000 career transformations. Developed and optimized features for a platform serving 900+ placement partners, ensuring scalability and performance. Designed and maintained RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless integration between Scaler's web application and mobile platforms.

Maintained and developed data within the SAP ecosystem, leveraging ABAP, SAPUI5, and SAP HANA technologies. Enhanced vendor invoice workflow efficiency by 15% through process optimization and format pattern recognition.

Developed and executed comprehensive test plans and workforce breakdown structures for games released on PlayStation and Xbox. Tested hardware and software within tightly controlled sandbox environments prior to release to production.
